hero.title: Quel budget pour un studio photo automatise ?
hero.subtitle: Fourchettes de prix, cout par photo et retour sur investissement : tout ce qu'il faut savoir avant d'investir.

intro.p1: Combien coute un studio photo automatise ? La question est legitime, et nous allons y repondre avec la transparence que vous meritez. Pas de tarif cache, pas de surprise : voici les ordres de grandeur reels du marche, les facteurs qui influencent le prix, et surtout le calcul qui transforme cette depense en investissement rentable.
intro.p2: Chez PackshotCreator, nous distribuons la gamme Orbitvu depuis plus de 20 ans. Nous connaissons chaque machine, chaque cas d'usage, et nous avons accompagne plus de 500 entreprises dans leur passage a la photo automatisee. Voici ce que nous avons appris.

factors.heading: Ce qui influence le prix d'un studio photo automatise
factors.body: Le budget d'un studio photo automatise depend de quatre facteurs principaux. Chacun d'entre eux oriente le choix de la machine et donc l'investissement final.
factors.f1: La taille de vos produits : un flacon de parfum et un canape ne se photographient pas dans le meme studio. Les machines compactes conviennent aux produits de moins de 40 cm, les grands formats accueillent des meubles jusqu'a 3 metres.
factors.f2: Le volume de production : 500 photos par an ou 50 000 ? Le volume quotidien conditionne le niveau d'automatisation necessaire et donc le positionnement dans la gamme.
factors.f3: Les types de visuels : packshot fond blanc, photo 360 interactive, video produit, flat-lay textile, ghost mannequin... Chaque format necessite des fonctionnalites specifiques.
factors.f4: Le niveau d'automatisation souhaite : d'un studio semi-automatique avec reglages manuels a un systeme full-auto avec intelligence artificielle, l'ecart de prix reflete le gain de temps au quotidien.

ranges.heading: Les fourchettes de prix des studios Orbitvu

compact.description: Studios de bureau pour produits de petite et moyenne taille (jusqu'a 40 cm). Ideal pour demarrer ou pour les volumes moderes.

polyvalent.description: Studios multi-formats pour produits moyens a grands. Plusieurs types de visuels (packshot, flat-lay, 360, video) dans un seul systeme.

polyvalent.l2: Capacite : 180 a 300 visuels par jour selon le modele

grandVolume.l3: Fonctions : mannequins vivants, lifestyle, plateau 1 tonne

costPerPhoto.heading: Combien coute reellement une photo produit ?
costPerPhoto.body: Le prix d'un studio ne signifie rien s'il est deconnecte du cout reel par photo. C'est ce cout unitaire qui determine la rentabilite de l'investissement. Voici un comparatif base sur les prix constates en France.
costPerPhoto.highlight: Avec un studio automatise, le cout par photo est divise par 5 a 10 par rapport a la prestation externe.

roi.heading: Retour sur investissement : les chiffres
roi.body: Un studio photo automatise n'est pas une depense, c'est un investissement dont le retour se mesure en mois, pas en annees. Nos clients constatent un seuil de rentabilite des 500 photos par an. Pour les gros volumes, le ROI est atteint des le quatrieme mois d'utilisation.
roi.conclusion: Un operateur forme produit en moyenne 300 packshots par jour avec un studio Orbitvu, contre 30 sans automatisation. A 5 000 photos par an, les economies atteignent 60 a 85 % par rapport a la sous-traitance. Le calcul est vite fait.

included.heading: Ce qui est inclus dans le prix
included.body: Le prix d'un studio Orbitvu n'est pas celui de la machine seule. C'est une solution complete, prete a produire des la livraison. Pas de surprise, pas de cout supplementaire a prevoir.

hero.title: How much does an automated photo studio cost?
hero.subtitle: Price ranges, cost per photo, and return on investment: everything you need to know before investing.

intro.p1: How much does an automated photo studio cost? It is a fair question, and we are going to answer it with the transparency you deserve. No hidden fees, no surprises: here are real market price ranges, the factors that influence pricing, and most importantly, the math that turns this expense into a profitable investment.
intro.p2: At PackshotCreator, we have been distributing the Orbitvu range for over 20 years. We know every machine, every use case, and we have helped more than 500 companies transition to automated photography. Here is what we have learned.

factors.heading: What influences the price of an automated photo studio
factors.body: The budget for an automated photo studio depends on four main factors. Each of them determines the right machine and therefore the final investment.
factors.f1: The size of your products: a perfume bottle and a sofa do not require the same studio. Compact machines handle products up to 40 cm, while large-format systems accommodate furniture up to 3 meters.
factors.f2: Production volume: 500 photos per year or 50,000? Your daily volume determines the level of automation needed and therefore your position in the range.
factors.f3: Types of visuals: white-background packshot, interactive 360 view, product video, textile flat-lay, ghost mannequin... Each format requires specific capabilities.
factors.f4: Level of automation desired: from a semi-automatic studio with manual adjustments to a fully automated AI-powered system, the price difference reflects daily time savings.

ranges.heading: Orbitvu studio price ranges
ranges.intro: The Orbitvu range covers every need, from desktop studios to industrial systems. Here are the three main price families, with the relevant models and their capabilities.

compact.title: Compact
compact.description: Desktop studios for small to medium-sized products (up to 40 cm). Ideal for getting started or for moderate volumes.
compact.l1: Models: Alphashot 360, Alphashot G2, Alphashot Pro G2
compact.l3: Features: packshot, 360, video, automatic background removal

polyvalent.title: Versatile
polyvalent.description: Multi-format studios for medium to large products. Multiple visual types (packshot, flat-lay, 360, video) in a single system.
polyvalent.l1: Models: Alphashot XL, Alphadesk, Alphastudio Compact
polyvalent.l2: Capacity: 180 to 300 visuals per day depending on model
polyvalent.l3: Features: multi-camera, ghost mannequin, textile flat-lay

grandVolume.title: High volume
grandVolume.description: Industrial solutions for fashion, furniture, and very high volumes. High-capacity turntables, professional oversized lighting.
grandVolume.l1: Models: Fashion Studio, Furniture Studio, E-Comm Studio+
grandVolume.l2: Capacity: 60 to 150 visuals per day, products up to 3 meters

costPerPhoto.heading: What does a product photo really cost?
costPerPhoto.body: A studio price means nothing if it is disconnected from the real cost per photo. It is this unit cost that determines the profitability of the investment. Here is a comparison based on prices observed in the market.
costPerPhoto.highlight: With an automated studio, the cost per photo is divided by 5 to 10 compared to external providers.

roi.heading: Return on investment: the numbers
roi.body: An automated photo studio is not an expense, it is an investment whose return is measured in months, not years. Our clients reach break-even from as few as 500 photos per year. For high-volume users, ROI is achieved as early as the fourth month of use.
roi.conclusion: A trained operator produces an average of 300 packshots per day with an Orbitvu studio, compared to 30 without automation. At 5,000 photos per year, savings reach 60 to 85% compared to outsourcing. The math speaks for itself.

included.heading: What is included in the price
included.body: The price of an Orbitvu studio is not just for the machine. It is a complete solution, ready to produce from the day it is delivered. No surprises, no additional costs to plan for.

i1.title: Complete studio
i1.description: Enclosure, LED lighting, motorized turntable, camera (depending on configuration).

i2.title: Orbitvu Station software
i2.description: Capture, automatic background removal (IQ Mask), multi-format export, updates included.

i3.title: On-site training
i3.description: Hands-on training by a certified trainer. Full autonomy in 1 hour for routine operations.

i4.title: Installation and calibration
i4.description: On-site setup by our technicians, color and lighting calibration.

i5.title: French-speaking technical support
i5.description: France-based team, support by phone and video conference.

i6.title: Maintenance: EUR 0/year
i6.description: No mandatory maintenance contract. Consumables: EUR 400 to 2,500/year depending on model.

financing.heading: Financing options
financing.body: Investing in an automated photo studio can be spread over time. Several options exist to adapt financing to your cash flow.

f1.title: Leasing from EUR 344/month
f1.description: For the Alphashot Pro G2, our best-selling model. Fixed monthly payment, controlled budget.

f2.title: OPCO funding (up to 100%)
f2.description: Our training programs are Qualiopi-certified. The training component of your investment can be fully covered by your OPCO (French training fund).

f3.title: 5-year depreciation
f3.description: The studio is a depreciable asset over 5 years. Depreciation reduces your tax base every year.

f4.title: Tax advantage (25% corporate tax)
f4.description: Studio depreciation is deductible from corporate income tax at the 25% rate, reducing the real cost of the investment.

q1.question: Do you publish your prices?
q1.answer: We publish price ranges to give you a realistic sense of scale. The exact price depends on your chosen configuration (camera, options, accessories) and is provided through a personalized quote after analyzing your needs.

q2.question: What is your best-selling studio?
q2.answer: The Alphashot Pro G2 is our best-seller. It is the world's first AI-powered photo studio. It is suitable for most products under 40 cm and starts at EUR 344 per month on a lease.

q3.question: Is the software included in the price?
q3.answer: Yes. Orbitvu Station is included with every studio, with no subscription. You get automatic background removal (IQ Mask), multi-format export, and all future software updates.

q4.question: Can training be funded through OPCO?
q4.answer: Yes. Our Academy is Qualiopi-certified, making our training programs eligible for OPCO funding. Depending on your industry sector, coverage can reach 100% of the training cost.

q5.question: What ROI can I expect?
q5.answer: On average, our clients reach break-even in 6 to 12 months. For companies producing more than 1,000 visuals per year, ROI can be achieved as early as the 4th month. Use our online ROI calculator for a personalized estimate.

q6.question: Are there any hidden costs?
q6.answer: No. There is no mandatory maintenance contract (EUR 0/year). The only recurring costs are consumables (backgrounds, positioning accessories): EUR 400 to 2,500 per year depending on model and usage.
